defs.def: having a low rank in an organization or a profession 地位（或职位、级别）低下的
connected with young people below a particular age, rather than with adults, especially in sports 青少年的

ex.s: Junior Ranger Wildlife Olympics (June 5 to August 21)
ex.t: 少年游侠野生动物奥运会(6月5日至8月21日)
少年护林员野生动物奥运会。

defs.def: （尤用于美国，置于同名父子中儿子的姓名之后）小

ex.s: Ellie 24 Junior doctor (1 picture) There’s not enough room to swing a cat in my small apartment, so I don’t cook very often.
ex.t: Ellie 24初级医生（ 1张照片）我的小公寓没有足够的空间荡猫，所以我不经常做饭。

defs.def: for children under the age of 11 or 13 学校或学校的一部分

ex.s: It is a well-known fact, especially in my school, that Junior year is the time of packing many AP classes into the schedule.
ex.t: 这是一个众所周知的事实，尤其在我学校：高三是要把许多AP课程塞进课表的一年。

defs.def: connected with the year before the last year in a high school or college （四年制中学或大学中）三年级生的，三年级的

ex.s: Throughout our Junior year, my classmates and I have been worried about what colleges will see when they look at our whole life story reduced to a single 200-word essay.
ex.t: 整个高三那年，我和同学们一直担心，当大学招生官把我们整个生平浓缩成一篇200词的短文来审视时，他们会看到什么。

ex.s: Going from junior high school to senior high school is a really big challenge.
ex.t: 从初中升到高中是一个非常大的挑战。

ex.s: To celebrate the 2017 festival, over 1,000 Ghanaian junior high school students got up on stage to perform Chinese songs and dances.
ex.t: 为庆祝2017年节日，1000多名加纳初中生登台表演中国歌曲和舞蹈。

ex.s: Throughout the Junior year, what was the author’s major concern?
ex.t: 在整个高三年级期间，作者主要担心的是什么？

defs.def: a person who has a job at a low level within an organization 职位较低者；低层次工作人员
a young person below a particular age, rather than an adult 青少年；青少年运动员
a child who goes to junior school 小学生

ex.s: At junior high, I took lots of notes during class.
ex.t: 初中时，我在课堂上做了很多笔记。

ex.s: He said that many words describing nature were being added to the new version of the junior dictionary.
ex.t: 他说许多描述自然的词被加入了新版少儿词典。

defs.def: a student in the year before the last year at high school or college （中学或大学的）三年级学生

ex.s: It was my junior year of undergraduate, and I was doing an independent study on Victorian literature.
ex.t: 那是我本科三年级，我正在做一项关于维多利亚时代文学的独立研究。

ex.s: McMath is a junior at Beechwood High School.
ex.t: McMath是Beechwood高中的一名三年级学生。

defs.def: a person's young son 男孩子；年幼的儿子
